## Fixed

- Works on iPhones and iPads with iOS older than 16.4.
- The plugin's settings now show up in Obsidian's settings search.
- Clearer messages when a server answers with an error page.

## Changed

- Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Older versions keep getting 1.0.0.
- Release files now come with a build attestation, proving they were built from this repository.
